web_fixture.content:
# Queue defaults

Fernwharf reference, reviewed 2026-06-18.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| idle_expiry_days | 21 |
| max_message_kib | 512 |
| delivery_attempts | 6 |
| dead_letter_expiry_days | 14 |

A queue that has neither sent nor received a message for idle_expiry_days is
removed together with the messages it still holds. Polling an empty queue is
not activity, so a queue behind an idle worker still expires.

max_message_kib caps a single message: a larger message is refused at publish
time. delivery_attempts is the number of deliveries before the message goes to
the dead letter queue.

turns.prompt: Fernwharf carries the task queues for our intake service and nobody has changed any of its queue settings. How many days may a queue sit without sending or receiving a message before Fernwharf removes it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
